Supermarkets in Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Finland Hit by Suspected Freezer Hack. Supermarkets across Europe were hit by suspected cyberattacks that resulted in sudden changes in the temperatures of their fridges and freezers on Monday, echoing a more widespread problem in France last month. Incidents were reported in Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Finland and Estonia, but the overall impact of the incidents appeared to be far more limited than the French cyberattacks, potentially affecting just dozens of locations.
